# pacer

## Forms

### `(target …)`

Compose-mode target declaration: names an animatable property so the score compiles, is corpus-tested, and lints standalone without a host. At load, declared targets MERGE with the host registries — a name the host also provides is host-authoritative (its arity must agree, else target_arity_mismatch; the declared :registry is ignored), and a declared-only name is appended to the join under its :registry. :name and :arity are schema-optional so a missing one — or a duplicate :name — surfaces as target_decl_invalid (with a span).

| Key | Type | Required | Default | Constraints |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `:name` | `symbol` | no | — | Target identifier, joined by name against the host registries. |
| `:arity` | `number` | no | — | integer; min 1; max 4<br>Component count (1..4); must match the host's if the host also provides this name. |
| `:registry` | `number` | no | `0` | integer; min 0; max 255<br>Registry index for a declared-only target. Ignored for a name the host already provides (host-authoritative). |

### `(transport …)`

Global clock: tempo, meter, duration, end behavior. One per score.

| Key | Type | Required | Default | Constraints |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `:bpm` | `number` | yes | — | min 1; max 1000<br>Beats per minute. |
| `:meter` | `vector<number>` | no | `[4 4]` | len 2; integer; min 1; max 16<br>Time signature. One bar = one tick-grid cycle. |
| `:dur` | `number+unit` | no | — | unit `b`/`bar`/`s`<br>Score length. Required when :end is loop. |
| `:end` | `symbol enum` | no | `hold` | one of: `loop`, `hold`<br>Playhead behavior past :dur. |
| `:emit` | `vector<symbol>` | no | — | Reserved time names (beat, bar, phase, bpm, t) broadcast as write lanes, each resolved against the host registries by that exact name. Emitted lanes land before track writes, so an explicit (track …) on the same target overrides an emitted lane; controls still land last. |

### `(tempo …)`

A tempo change: from :at onward the transport runs at :bpm, until the next (tempo …) or the end of the score. One form per change, strictly ascending in document order.

| Key | Type | Required | Default | Constraints |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `:at` | `number+unit` | no | — | unit `b`/`bar`/`s`<br>Segment start: > 0, b/bar units only (an s position would need the map being defined), strictly ascending across (tempo …) forms. |
| `:bpm` | `number` | no | — | min 1; max 1000<br>Tempo in effect from :at onward. Fractional tempi are legal. |

### `(scene …)`

A named window [at, at+dur) on the transport tick grid; child tracks and triggers resolve their positions scene-relative. Scenes may overlap and hand a target off by write order. :name/:at/:dur are schema-optional so a scene missing any surfaces as a pacer scene_invalid diagnostic (with a span), not a bare SJON missing-key error.

| Key | Type | Required | Default | Constraints |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `:name` | `symbol` | no | — | Scene identifier; unique per score. |
| `:at` | `number+unit` | no | — | unit `b`/`bar`/`s`<br>Window start on the transport grid; beats/bars convert exactly. |
| `:dur` | `number+unit` | no | — | unit `b`/`bar`/`s`<br>Window length; the child tracks play over [at, at+dur). |

Positional children: `form: (track …) | (trigger …)`.

### `(track …)`

One animated target with exactly one value source: keyframe children interpolated with easing programs, XOR an :expr evaluated every frame, XOR a :pattern queried on the bar grid. Hosts receive final values and never interpolate.

| Key | Type | Required | Default | Constraints |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `:target` | `symbol` | yes | — | Resolved at load() against the ordered host registries; unresolved names are a load diagnostic, not a schema error. |
| `:expr` | `any` | no | — | Expression evaluated each frame with the time env bound (t, tick, beat, bar, cycle, phase, bpm, dur) plus every (control …) id. Must yield a finite number or an ncomp-component numeric vector. Exclusive with (key …) children and :pattern. |
| `:pattern` | `any` | no | — | Pattern queried each frame on the shared tick grid, 1 cycle = 1 bar. At tick T the hap active at T with the latest onset supplies the value; no active hap omits the write. Exclusive with (key …) children and :expr. |

Positional children: `form: (key …, local)`.

Exclusive group (at_most_one): `:expr` | `:pattern`.

#### `(key …)`

A keyframe. Before the first key a track holds its first value; after the last, its last.

| Key | Type | Required | Default | Constraints |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `:at` | `number+unit` | yes | — | unit `b`/`bar`/`s`<br>Position on the shared tick grid; beats/bars convert exactly, seconds via one documented mul+floor. |
| `:value` | `plain-number \| vec-value` | yes | — | repr f32; min-len 1; max-len 4; repr f32<br>Value reached exactly at :at. |
| `:ease` | `ease-name \| ease-form` | no | `linear` | one of: `linear`, `hold`, `smoothstep`, `in-quad`, `out-quad`, `in-out-quad`, `in-cubic`, `out-cubic`, `in-out-cubic`, `in-quart`, `out-quart`, `in-out-quart`, `in-sine`, `out-sine`, `in-out-sine`, `in-expo`, `out-expo`, `in-out-expo`<br>Easing applied over the segment ENDING at this key. |

### `(trigger …)`

An event lane. At each frame it finds the last scheduled event <= the playhead and writes (phase, count, gate, beats-since) lanes truncated to the target's ncomp. The schedule is EITHER periodic (:every, phased by optional :offset) XOR an explicit ascending :at list — both keys are schema-optional so a missing/duplicated source, a non-positive :every, or an empty/unsorted :at surface as a pacer trigger_invalid diagnostic (with a span), not a bare SJON error.

| Key | Type | Required | Default | Constraints |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `:target` | `symbol` | yes | — | Resolved at load() against the ordered host registries, like a track's target. |
| `:every` | `number+unit` | no | — | unit `b`/`bar`/`s`<br>Periodic interval between events; must be > 0 ticks. Exclusive with :at. |
| `:offset` | `number+unit` | no | — | unit `b`/`bar`/`s`; requires `:every`<br>Phase of the periodic schedule — event k lands at :offset + k*:every; defaults to 0. That default is the one this manifest cannot declare: a :default is unit-free, and dropping the unit off a time-pos would be silent — so it lives in Compile.zig. Meaningless without :every, hence :requires — an :offset beside an explicit :at is dependent_key_missing, not a silent no-op. |
| `:at` | `vector<number+unit>` | no | — | unit `b`/`bar`/`s`<br>Explicit event positions, strictly ascending in time. Exclusive with :every. |

Exclusive group (exactly_one): `:every` | `:at`.

### `(control …)`

A pinned editor widget — pins ARE text. :value is the document authority: written to :target every frame while the control is idle, and bound under :id in every track expression. A live drv_setControl override wins until drv_clearControl returns authority to the document. Control writes land after track writes; consumers apply entries in order, so a pin outranks a track on the same target.

| Key | Type | Required | Default | Constraints |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `:id` | `symbol` | yes | — | Binding name in the expression environment. |
| `:type` | `symbol enum` | no | `slider` | one of: `slider`, `xy`, `color`<br>Editor widget hint, and the discriminant: slider and xy carry :min/:max, color does not. Write it BEFORE :min/:max — a variant key ahead of its discriminant is unknown_key. |
| `:target` | `symbol` | no | — | Optional write target, resolved like a track's. Without one the control only feeds expressions (a virtual knob). |
| `:value` | `plain-number \| vec-value` | yes | — | repr f32; min-len 1; max-len 4; repr f32<br>Document value: scalar or 1-4 component vector. Its byte span rides in drv_meta so the editor can commit a drag back to text. |

#### Variant `:type [slider xy]`

| Key | Type | Required | Default | Constraints |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `:min` | `plain-number \| vec-value` | no | — | repr f32; min-len 1; max-len 4; repr f32<br>Widget range floor — editor metadata; the driver never clamps. Arity must match :value. |
| `:max` | `plain-number \| vec-value` | no | — | repr f32; min-len 1; max-len 4; repr f32<br>Widget range ceiling — editor metadata; the driver never clamps. Arity must match :value. |

### `(seq …)`

Stages concatenated in time and value acting as one easing: :t/:v weights are normalized at compile so the program still lands exactly on the key value.

Positional children: `form: (stage …, local)`.

#### `(stage …)`

One (seq …) stage.

| Key | Type | Required | Default | Constraints |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `:ease` | `ease-name \| ease-form` | yes | — | one of: `linear`, `hold`, `smoothstep`, `in-quad`, `out-quad`, `in-out-quad`, `in-cubic`, `out-cubic`, `in-out-cubic`, `in-quart`, `out-quart`, `in-out-quart`, `in-sine`, `out-sine`, `in-out-sine`, `in-expo`, `out-expo`, `in-out-expo`<br>Easing shaping this stage (nesting depth is capped at compile). |
| `:t` | `number` | yes | — | min 0; repr f32<br>Relative time weight. |
| `:v` | `number` | yes | — | repr f32<br>Relative value span; may be negative (the pull-back of a bounce). |

### `(chain …)`

Function composition: (chain E1 E2) evaluates E2(E1(u)). For shaping, e.g. quantizing a spring through steps.

Positional children: `ease-name | ease-form` (one of: `linear`, `hold`, `smoothstep`, `in-quad`, `out-quad`, `in-out-quad`, `in-cubic`, `out-cubic`, `in-out-cubic`, `in-quart`, `out-quart`, `in-out-quart`, `in-sine`, `out-sine`, `in-out-sine`, `in-expo`, `out-expo`, `in-out-expo`).

### `(steps …)`

Stair-step easing.

| Key | Type | Required | Default | Constraints |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `:n` | `number` | yes | — | integer; min 1; max 64 |
| `:jump` | `symbol enum` | no | `end` | one of: `start`, `end`<br>Which end of the tread jumps. |

### `(cubic-bezier …)`

CSS cubic-bezier(): solved by fixed-count bisection (bit-exact, no epsilon early-exit).

| Key | Type | Required | Default | Constraints |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `:p` | `vector<number>` | yes | — | len 4; repr f32 |

### `(spring …)`

Closed-form damped cosine settling exactly on the key value at u=1.

| Key | Type | Required | Default | Constraints |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `:damping` | `number` | yes | — | min 0; max 1 |
| `:periods` | `number` | no | `3` | min 0.5; max 16<br>Oscillation count over the segment. |

## Value kinds

### time-pos

Score position / duration: a number carrying a required unit — b (beats), bar (bars), or s (seconds).

Type: `number+unit` — unit `b`/`bar`/`s`.

### bpm-value

Tempo in beats per minute. Fractional tempi are legal (e.g. 128.5).

Type: `number` — min 1; max 1000.

### meter-component

Time-signature component: integer 1..16 (the tick grid subdivides exactly in that range).

Type: `number` — integer; min 1; max 16.

### meter-pair

Time signature as [beats-per-bar note-value], e.g. [4 4].

Type: `vector<number>` — len 2; integer; min 1; max 16.

### end-behavior

What the driver does when the playhead passes :dur.

Type: `symbol enum` — one of: `loop`, `hold`.

### emit-lanes

Built-in clock lanes: a list of reserved time names, each written every frame to the host target of the same name (before track writes).

Type: `vector<symbol>`.

### plain-number

Unitless number. Narrowed to f32 at write-buffer encode, so it must fit that range.

Type: `number` — repr f32.

### vec-value

Vector of 1-4 numbers (vec2/vec3/vec4 targets).

Type: `vector<number>` — min-len 1; max-len 4; repr f32.

### key-value

Keyframe value: a scalar or a 1-4 component vector. Arity is joined against the resolved target at load.

Type: `plain-number | vec-value` — repr f32; min-len 1; max-len 4; repr f32.

### target-name

Target resolved at load() against the host registries (visual uniforms, audio params).

Type: `symbol`.

### target-arity

Component count a declared target expects: integer 1..4.

Type: `number` — integer; min 1; max 4.

### registry-index

Host registry a declared-only target routes to: 0 = visual uniforms, 1 = audio params, …

Type: `number` — integer; min 0; max 255.

### scene-name

Scene identifier: names a window [at, at+dur) on the transport grid. Unique per score; the studio timeline displays it and scene-local expr env keys off it.

Type: `symbol`.

### time-pos-list

Explicit event positions for a (trigger …): a vector of time-pos values (b/bar/s). Emptiness and ordering are joined at compile as trigger_invalid, not schema errors.

Type: `vector<number+unit>` — unit `b`/`bar`/`s`.

### control-id

Expression-environment binding name for a control. Unique per score; the reserved time names (t, tick, beat, bar, cycle, phase, bpm, dur) are rejected at load.

Type: `symbol`.

### control-type

Editor widget hint. The driver carries it through drv_meta and never interprets it.

Type: `symbol enum` — one of: `slider`, `xy`, `color`.

### ease-name

Named easing primitive.

Type: `symbol enum` — one of: `linear`, `hold`, `smoothstep`, `in-quad`, `out-quad`, `in-out-quad`, `in-cubic`, `out-cubic`, `in-out-cubic`, `in-quart`, `out-quart`, `in-out-quart`, `in-sine`, `out-sine`, `in-out-sine`, `in-expo`, `out-expo`, `in-out-expo`.

### ease-form

Easing combinator form.

Type: `form: (seq …) | (chain …) | (steps …) | (cubic-bezier …) | (spring …)`.

### ease-spec

An easing: a named primitive or a combinator form.

Type: `ease-name | ease-form` — one of: `linear`, `hold`, `smoothstep`, `in-quad`, `out-quad`, `in-out-quad`, `in-cubic`, `out-cubic`, `in-out-cubic`, `in-quart`, `out-quart`, `in-out-quart`, `in-sine`, `out-sine`, `in-out-sine`, `in-expo`, `out-expo`, `in-out-expo`.

### stage-weight

Relative weight (normalized once at compile, fixed op order). Lands in the f32 program table.

Type: `number` — min 0; repr f32.

### step-count

Stair-step count.

Type: `number` — integer; min 1; max 64.

### jump-mode

Which end of each stair tread jumps (CSS steps() semantics subset).

Type: `symbol enum` — one of: `start`, `end`.

### bezier-points

CSS cubic-bezier control points [x1 y1 x2 y2]; x1/x2 must lie in [0,1] (checked at ease compile).

Type: `vector<number>` — len 4; repr f32.

### damping-ratio

Spring damping ratio in (0,1]: 1 = critically damped, lower = bouncier. Zero never settles and is rejected at ease compile.

Type: `number` — min 0; max 1.

### period-count

Spring oscillation count over the segment.

Type: `number` — min 0.5; max 16.

### key-section

Keyframe children of (track …).

Type: `form: (key …)`.

### stage-section

Stage children of (seq …).

Type: `form: (stage …)`.

### scene-section

Track and trigger children of (scene …); both resolve their positions scene-relative.

Type: `form: (track …) | (trigger …)`.
